Senses.Explanation: ‘Separate transmission outside the teachings’ distinguishes Chan transmission from receiving doctrine through explanation. It does not prohibit speech, writing, or study. Weilin says Yongjia’s song sets forth it; Runguang links getting it with handling the cases rather than picking through sentences; Hyujeong says even ordinary coarse and fine speech can express it, while the flower and smile become mere teaching traces when missed. Huishan presents the anti-study objection and answers that investigation and study must not be discarded for one another. Heshan records the flower-sermon origin as a received lineage story.
Senses.Note: Outside does not mean rejection of all language, writing, or study. Heshan's flower-sermon origin is received lineage narrative, not verified history.

Senses.Explanation: “Teeth like sword-trees, mouth like a blood-basin” gives dangerous physical form to formidable speech. Tian’an Sheng applies it to the clear-eyed person; Daxiu Zhu and Xueguan Zhiyin use it in portraits of Dahui Zonggao and Tianyin Yuanxiu; Wuyi Yuanlai applies it to Vimalakirti’s torrent of questions and argument. Tian’an Sheng places the pair beside the clear-eyed person who has no fixed lair. Daxiu Zhu’s praise of Dahui follows it with Dahui’s scolding of teachers throughout the regions. Wuyi Yuanlai sets the image beside questions rising like clouds and argument pouring from a bottle; Xueguan Zhiyin gives it as the reason monks cannot safely provoke Tianyin Yuanxiu.

Occurrences.Kwic: 法茶毗，勿令衣麻而哭。言畢書偈，泊然而逝。世壽七十九，僧臘六十二。茶毗頂骨不壞，舍利叢布灰燼中，建塔瘞于東岡。天池信禪師法嗣天池信禪師法嗣建寧府天寶鐵關法樞禪師建寧府天寶鐵關法樞禪師溫之平陽林氏子。年十七，往常州華藏寺，禮竺西坦受業。十九得度，二十受具。初參中峰，次謁及菴，皆不契。聞元翁信主秀之石門，造而諮叩。信示以南泉三不是話。經三年，一日大悟，述偈曰：不是心佛物，拶出虗空骨。金毛師子兒，豈戀野狐窟。喝一喝：咄，咄，咄！即詣方丈。信問：作甚麼？師曰：南泉被我捉敗了也。信曰：不是心，不是佛，不是物，是箇什麼？師曰：牙齒一具骨，耳朵兩片皮。信曰：不是，不是，別道將來。師曰：鶯啼燕語，鵲噪鴉鳴。信曰：錯。師亦曰：錯。信曰：南泉即今在什麼處？師便喝。信曰：離却者一喝，南泉畢竟在什麼處？師拂袖便出。由是徧謁諸方，見虗谷陵於大仰，復謁海印如於饒之薦福。纔上方丈，如問：誰？師曰：暫到相看。如曰：什麼處來？師曰：江西。如曰：江西近日有什麼事？師曰：集雲峰下藤條被人抝折了也。如曰：莫亂統。師曰：不因亂統，爭得到者裏？如曰：且道者裏事作麼生？師叉手進前，曰：即日恭惟堂頭和尚尊候起居萬福。如曰：不涉泥水一句作麼生？師喝一喝，曰：風從虎，雲從龍。如曰：一喝
